Name: Shamgar, Son of Anath
Summary: Shamgar, son of Anath, killed six hundred Philistines with an ox goad and also delivered Israel.
KeyStory: Shamgar, named between Ehud and Deborah, slew six hundred Philistines with an ox goad and also delivered Israel.
LifeLesson: Deliverance does not always come with an army — sometimes with a farmer's tool.
